en: Monochrome vintage postcard showing the tall spires of Saint Nicholas Church rising above trees and old tile‑roofed houses, with wooded mountains in the background. A small gatehouse and archway stand in the foreground. Caption at bottom reads "Brașov — Biserica Sft. Nicolae — Piața Prundului." The reverse bears Romanian stamps, a 1933 postmark, handwritten message and address, and the publisher imprint "Editura Librăria Cooperativă, Brașov."
